name: PixiTween Director S14: compact studio shell (rail, stepper, resizable panels)
description: Replace the scrolling card page and the three-column crew page with one full-height studio: header stepper, left icon rail that switches the left panel, resizable stage and side panel (react-resizable-panels), filmstrip under the player, compact panels. Layout and markup only: no server, shared contract or engine change.

userStories.title: Add react-resizable-panels, Icon set and shell hooks
userStories.description: As a studio developer, I want the resizable-panel dependency, an icon set and two small hooks so that the shell can be built on tested pieces.
steps: Read docs/studio-ui-redesign-spec.md sections 5 and 8, package.json and web/src/test-setup.ts.
Run `npm install react-resizable-panels@3.0.6` (the version app-eyecast-app-frontend uses) and keep the lockfile change.
Create web/src/shell/Icon.tsx exporting Icon({name,size}) with inline SVG paths for plus, list, users, eye, bolt, download, grid, chat, sun and moon (stroke currentColor, aria-hidden).

Create web/src/shell/hooks.ts exporting useWide(query = '(min-width: 900px)') that returns true when window.matchMedia is missing, and useTheme() that reads and writes localStorage key 'studio.theme' inside try/catch and sets or removes data-theme on document.documentElement.
Add a ResizeObserver stub to web/src/test-setup.ts only if the panel library needs one in jsdom; add web/src/shell/hooks.test.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: useWide returns true in jsdom where window.matchMedia is undefined, and follows a mocked matchMedia 'change' event
useTheme().toggle() sets data-theme='dark' on <html>, and still returns a value when localStorage.setItem throws
package.json lists react-resizable-panels at 3.0.6 under dependencies
`npm run typecheck` passes
`npm test` passes (offline, no network)
`npm run lint` passes
userStories.notes: done by ralph; theme hook now follows the system setting when nothing is stored

userStories.title: StudioShell: header, stepper, rail and resizable panels (wide)
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want one full-height page with a rail, a stepper and resizable panels so that the player and the tools are visible together.
steps: Read docs/studio-ui-redesign-spec.md (the section named in the story), web/src/App.tsx and web/src/crew/CrewStudio.tsx. Focus on sections 3 and 6.

Create web/src/shell/StudioShell.tsx with the props listed in the spec (title, status, steps, step, tabs, defaultTab, stage, strip, side, sideTitle, headerRight, testId). Wide layout: header (brand, title, stepper as an ordered list of buttons, headerRight, status chip with class 'status-chip st-<status>' plus a visually hidden span data-testid='film-status', theme button, side-panel toggle), icon rail (role=tablist, one role=tab button per tab with aria-selected and a data-testid 'rail-<id>'), and a horizontal PanelGroup with autoSaveId='studio-main': collapsible left Panel (default 27%, 18-45%), stage Panel, collapsible side Panel (default 26%, 18-45%).

Render every tab's content inside a div with the 'hidden' attribute when inactive, so inactive panes stay mounted. Clicking the active tab collapses the left panel through the imperative handle; clicking another tab expands it and selects it.

Create web/src/shell/shell.css: root `height:100dvh; overflow:hidden`, panes scroll on their own, 6 px resize handle with a 2 px accent line on hover and drag ([data-resize-handle-state]), pane chrome override so '.slot' inside a pane has no border, radius, shadow or background, tokens from web/src/styles/theme.css only.
Add web/src/shell/StudioShell.test.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking tab 'plan' shows its pane and sets hidden on the others while all pane contents stay in the DOM
Clicking the already-active tab collapses the left panel (the tab's aria-selected becomes false) and clicking it again expands it
The stepper marks steps before `step` with class 'is-done', the current one with aria-current='step', and clicking a step with a tab selects that tab
The status prop 'ready' renders an element with data-testid='film-status' whose text is 'ready'
`npm run typecheck` passes
`npm test` passes (offline, no network)
`npm run lint` passes
Verify in the browser (dev-browser skill or preview): `npm run dev`, open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, and record what you saw in `notes`
userStories.notes: done by hand (Claude): StudioShell, steps.ts, shell.css, badges and keyboard shortcuts included; tests in StudioShell.test.tsx

metadata.standingRule: Offline-only PRD. Every story is implementable and verifiable with unit tests, recorded fixtures and the browser preview; nothing here spends money or needs network. Live and paid checks are listed in metadata.manualGates and run by the owner.
guardrails: Work offline. Tests use recorded fixtures and DIRECTOR_REPLAY=1. Never call Meta, Clippy, Ollama or any other network service from a story, a test or a script you run during a story. The only network use allowed is `npm install`.
Never commit, push, tag, publish to npm, deploy or change repository settings. autoCommit is off and the owner commits.
For engine behaviour (composition JSON, Player, timeline, layer kinds) read docs/engine/README.md before writing code; never edit or copy engine source.

Never edit anything under node_modules/. The engine `reacthub-pixitweenjs` is a dependency: if it lacks something, add a row to ENGINE-NEEDS.md (what, where, proposed API, workaround, story) and use a workaround or set notes to 'blocked: engine'.
Edit only the files named in the story's steps, plus their tests. Files under shared/ are contracts (specs/hackathon/meta/06-contracts.md): change them only in a story that says so.
Never put keys, tokens, cookies or personal data in code, fixtures, logs or docs. Fixtures are redacted: no Authorization headers and no data: URLs longer than 200 characters.
No real brand names, logos or real people's likeness in prompts, fixtures or assets.
Record only real results. Never invent measurements, latencies, prices or test output.
Do not add a dependency that the story or 06-contracts.md does not name. If one is truly needed, say why in notes.
Debug output goes to debug/<step>/iteration-NN/ (gitignored). Only curated, redacted fixtures are committed, under fixtures/<step>/.

A step that would call a paid or live API is written as a script that prints an estimate and exits unless `--yes` is passed (`npm run live -- <step> --yes`, one file per step under scripts/live/). Create such scripts; never run them.
Layout and markup only: do not change shared/, server/ or the engine, and keep every existing data-testid and accessible name unless the story says to change it.
Use only the tokens in web/src/styles/theme.css; both light and dark must stay readable and prefers-reduced-motion must be respected.
The only new dependency is react-resizable-panels@3.0.6. Do not copy source files from app-eyecast-app-frontend.
Wrap every localStorage access in try/catch; the page must render with storage blocked.

ui: Verify in the browser (dev-browser skill or preview): `npm run dev`, open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, and record what you saw in `notes`

manualGates: MG-UI: owner runs the fake crew (`DIRECTOR_FAKE=1 DIRECTOR_FAKE_DELAY_MS=1200 npm run dev:server` and `npm run dev:web`), opens a classic and a crew film at 1440x900 and 375x812 and confirms there is no page scroll on desktop, the panels resize and the stepper follows the status.
